The appointment brings the country's record goalscorer into the national team's backroom staff and comes just four months after he was named an ambassador for Ghana's national teams. The GFA announced the appointment Monday, saying Gyan will act as a link between the technical staff, players and their clubs, with responsibility for communication over call-ups and player welfare. He will also provide mentorship and support to the squad. "As Clubs and Player Relations Manager, Gyan will serve as a key liaison between the technical team, players and clubs, facilitate communication around player call-ups and welfare, and provide mentorship and support to the playing body," the GFA said in a statement. "His experience, leadership and deep connection with the current generation of players is expected to be a major asset for the team." Asamoah Gyan is Ghana's record goal-scorer, and has been appointed in a mentorship role for the Black Stars. Ghana FA This new position gives Gyan a more direct role with the Black Stars, with the GFA describing it as, "a new strategic role that will focus on strengthening the relationship between the national team, players, and their respective clubs, as well as improving player welfare and engagement." It comes after his appointment in May when he was named Ambassador for Ghana's National Teams and Colts Football. That brief was focused on promotion, fan engagement, corporate partnerships and youth football.
